mission.title: Scheduled Maintenance
mission.description: Escort a maintenance program to a damaged junction box and guard it during the repair.

npc.say: Repair complete! I'll just stick around for a while to tidy up. Thanks for your help, human.

phase.briefing: Although we have nearly finished securing our hardline system against further sabotage, there are still damaged hardline systems in a number of spots in the City. You will escort a hardline maintenance program to a damaged junction box and defend it while it makes the repair.

enter.say: The hardline program Norris The Mechanic is in that building. Lead him outside and wait for further directions.

objective.text: Lead Norris The Mechanic out of the area

phase.briefing: I am sending you a waypoint to the damaged junction box. Take Norris The Mechanic to the building indicated.

enter.say: The damaged junction box is in that building. Take Norris The Mechanic to it and guard him while he makes the repairs.
The junction box is in that room.

objective.text: Take Norris The Mechanic to the junction box

done.say: I'm picking up hostile programs en-route to your location. ETA: 15 seconds. Protect Norris The Mechanic at all costs.
There are no further hostile programs in the area. Your work is done there, operative.

objective.text: Do not let Norris The Mechanic die

mission.finish: Exiles are too disorganized and ignorant to make use of the hardline system, even if they could wrest control of it away from us. Nevertheless, it is best that we discourage them from all such endeavors. Your efforts here have helped to show them the error of their ways, {player}.
